Fixed the Discord Approve/Reject 'interaction failed' -> agent-never-resumed bug (CostSmith). Root cause: decision Views (ApprovalControls/ChoiceControls) were timeout=None but had NO custom_id and were never re-registered via add_view, so any card that outlived its posting process was orphaned -> click hit no listener -> Discord 'interaction failed' -> no resume. Compounded by on_ready wiping state['awaiting'], which also killed the typed-reply fallback on restart. Fix: stable thread-scoped custom_ids (persistent views, verified is_persistent True on discord.py 2.7.1), lazy thread resolution for restart-reconstructed views, persist choice options+multi, and on_ready now re-arms each pending card via client.add_view(message_id=...) instead of wiping awaiting (clears only 'running').

Fixed CostSmith 'concurrency limit' queueing: CostSmith was missing from the Switchboard write-lane concurrency map, so it fell to _default=1 and a second Discord message queued behind a running task. Added costsmith:3 to switchboard_config.json (matches dataops — same read/analysis class). Restarted daemon via preflight (PID 30324, connected 16:26:23); new limit live. CostSmith can now run up to 3 parallel sessions.

Closed the --check gap that let today's message-ignoring bug through: --check now ASSERTS the required event handlers (on_message, on_ready) are actually bound as coroutine functions on the client after registration, not merely that registration didn't raise. A dropped/relocated @client.event now FAILS the gate (exit 1) instead of silently producing a daemon that connects but ignores all messages. Verified: clean=exit 0, on_message decorator dropped=exit 1 with clear message, restored=exit 0.

Restored the missing @client.event on on_message — the daemon was connecting but silently ignoring ALL Discord messages (CostSmith thread 'not responding' was the symptom, but it affected every agent). Root cause: today's 15:06 edit relocated on_message's @client.event decorator onto decision_channel_ids; my earlier crash-loop fix removed the stray decorator but left on_message undecorated. Confirmed against git HEAD (both on_message + on_ready had @client.event). Fixed, --check PASS, daemon restarted via preflight (PID 74948, connected 15:49:49). Thread->session map survived restart, so agents resume on next reply.

Wired `switchboard.py --check` into sb-boot/sb-restart as a preflight gate in the PowerShell profile. A broken switchboard.py (failed handler registration) is now REFUSED before the daemon starts, so it can never enter the watchdog crash-loop that made sb-boot look dead this morning. Added _sb-Preflight helper, -SkipCheck bypass, updated the sb-* comment block. Profile parses clean; preflight verified True on clean code (exit-1/False on broken code proven earlier).

Added `switchboard.py --check` pre-deploy smoke test: builds the discord client and registers every @client.event / @tasks.loop handler exactly as a live boot would, then returns BEFORE client.run (no Gateway connection). Catches the runtime-only registration errors (non-async @client.event, bad @tasks.loop) that ast.parse can't see — the exact class of bug that crash-looped the daemon earlier today. Exit 0 = PASS, exit 1 + traceback + clear FAIL line = broken. Verified both directions (clean=PASS/0, reintroduced bug=FAIL/1).

Fixed Switchboard crash-loop: today's 15:06 off-menu edit left a stray @client.event decorator on the synchronous helper decision_channel_ids() (switchboard.py:1836), so the daemon threw 'event registered must be a coroutine function' on every startup and the watchdog relaunched it endlessly. sb-boot/sb-restart appeared to 'do nothing'. projects.name: Conversion-by-Source Attribution (ATC → Purchase)
projects.description: Extend the ATC-source attribution (live 2026-06-08, ThemeSmith atc-tracking.js -> GA4 -> DataOps raw_ga4_atc -> atc-source.html) from a top-of-funnel 'where do adds originate' view into a full-funnel 'which source converts' view. Today the atc_source signal rides only on the add_to_cart event, so we can see adds by source (pdp / collection-quickadd / upcart-upsell / cart / collection / other) but NOT which source actually drives purchases, revenue, or contribution margin. RECOMMENDED PATH (B): ThemeSmith stamps the source as a Shopify cart line-item property (_atc_source) at add-to-cart time; it persists through checkout natively and lands on the order line item; DataOps extends ingest_shopify.py to pull line-item customAttributes into raw_line_items as a first-class column; conversion-by-source becomes a clean SQL join against units sold / revenue / True Gross / margin that the pipeline already computes. This lands the source signal where the money is and joins to existing profit metrics, unlike the GA4-native alternative (Path A: item_list_name through to purchase) which is lossy and siloed in GA4 with no margin join. Live-cart instrumentation requires Justin sign-off before shipping.

projects.name: SEO Growth Program (Organic Search)
projects.description: Turn Teeccino's strong-but-under-clicked organic search position into measurable, revenue-weighted growth. Core insight from the 2026-06-10 GSC baseline: this is a CLICK problem, not a ranking problem â€” 93.5% of impressions already sit in the top 10, but site CTR is just 1.21% because a large share of impressions come from informational/definitional queries (the carob cluster alone is ~30% of impressions at ~0.47% CTR, SERP-suppressed by knowledge panels). Per Justin's 2026-06-10 decision, the program optimizes REVENUE-FIRST: commercial-intent queries on product/collection pages are prioritized over high-volume informational traffic. SearchSmith owns the outcome and routes the writes â€” title/meta + copy via CatalogSmith, on-page/schema/internal-links/CWV via ThemeSmith â€” then verifies each fix in GSC. Success is measured by per-fix CTR lift in the dashboard improvement ledger (clean causal attribution) and growth in commercial-query clicks (revenue proxy), not raw total clicks. Realistic 90-day target: +300-800 organic clicks/mo (+8% to +20% on a 3,927/mo base); the naive backlog figure (+1,948 at 3% CTR) is explicitly rejected as folklore because the carob SERP won't pay 3%.

incidents.title: Phantom-cleanup batch renamed SKUs on 19+ active free-item / GWP / donation / gift-box products
incidents.summary: Bulk SKU rename batch of 79 SKUs across 35 "phantom" products treated status=archived/draft/unlisted as phantom-eligible. Live BXGY discounts, FOTM Free Packet flow, Stay.ai bundles, donation upsell, and ~19 active free-item / GWP / Mystery Gift / gift-box products broke. Justin caught it on the live site ~90 min after the run; Shopkeeper reverted all 79 SKUs in 30 min, 0 failures.
incidents.rootCause: AgentSmith dispatched the cleanup with insufficient safety thinking. CatalogSmith's phantom signal (duplicate-SKU + non-active-status) inverts reality at Teeccino, where status=archived/draft/unlisted is the canonical hidden-but-active state for cart-addable products. Single safety guard (skip status=active) caught 48/83 entries; the remaining 35 included ~19 active products. Free Java Packet 7976160755960 — explicitly named in Shopkeeper CLAUDE.md as the FOTM Free Packet — got renamed despite being a hard-rule ID, because the hard-rule was in markdown text, not in a machine-readable refuse-list.
